posts.text:
On paper, England should beat Argentina.  

On average, England players are:

2 inches taller 
2 1/2 years younger
Faster frontline 

This game has a sense of the historic:

- first World Cup meeting in 24 yrs
- England trying to erase 60 years of pain
- Argentina can be the first back to back Champ in 60 years 
- First Messi match up against England.  He can do what Maradona did in 1986 
-  Unresolved political tension  

So much on the line.

Argentina is choosing to wear their away jersey in

The median age of first-time homebuyers in America:

-  1991: 27
-  2010: 30
-  2020: 33
-  2022: 36
-  2024: 38
-  2025: 40

Americans are delaying everything: 

getting married
having kids
buying a home
